eyebrow.zh: 离线 · 零 API key · 秒级

headline.zh:
代码注释里藏的指令
你的 agent 会照做——先拦下
headline.en:
Instructions hidden in comments
your agent will follow — block them first

sub.zh: 有人会把删库、偷密钥外发这类指令藏进注释、docstring 或 commit message，等 Claude Code / Cursor 读到并照做。PromptShield 在 agent 读取仓库、diff 或 PR 之前，把这些文本扫一遍——命中任何 HIGH 就让 CI 变红。
sub.en: Someone hides delete-the-repo or secret-stealing commands in comments, docstrings or commit messages, waiting for Claude Code or Cursor to read and follow them. Before your agent reads a repo, diff or PR, PromptShield scans that text — any HIGH turns CI red.

title.zh: 扫的是 agent 真会照做的那段文本
title.en: Scans the text your agent will actually follow

body.zh: 注释、docstring、commit message、markdown、配置、字符串字面量——这些 agent 会读进上下文并照做的文本，逐段扫一遍。同一行里一段字符串收尾后紧跟的注释、或紧挨着的第二段字符串也不漏扫——不再因收尾就静默跳过，藏在后面的注入照样命中。
body.en: Comments, docstrings, commit messages, markdown, config, string literals — the text an agent reads into context and acts on, scanned segment by segment. A comment or a second string tucked right after a same-line string's close is scanned too — no longer silently skipped past the close, so an injection hiding behind it is still caught.

title.zh: 五类藏起来的注入，都认得

body.zh: 对 agent 喊话覆盖指令、删库销数据、偷读密钥外发、骗 agent 滥用工具、用编码或 Unicode 藏载荷——五类都能命中；高噪声措辞二次确认压误报，让你信得过每一个告警。
body.en: Instruction overrides, data destruction, secret exfiltration, tool abuse, obfuscated payloads — five classes, all caught; noisy wording gets a second confirmation to keep false alarms down so every alert is one you trust.

title.zh: 藏在编码层背后的，照样抓

body.zh: 有人把注入塞进 base64、hex、零宽字符或同形字里躲过人工 review——每段文本会先解码再扫一遍，藏在编码层背后的注入照样命中。
body.en: Someone stuffs an injection into base64, hex, zero-width or homoglyph characters to dodge human review — every segment is decoded and rescanned, so an injection hidden behind an encoding layer is still caught.

title.zh: 基线和规则文件，怎么改都不会咬你
title.en: Your baseline and rules files won't bite you — however you edit them

body.zh: 留在仓库里的基线文件不会再把自己扫成误报 HIGH——它只压该压的，每一个告警都是真的。你整理已接受告警、或写自己的规则包时手误写错、或文件存成了错的字符编码，也不会甩出一长串看不懂的报错让 CI 莫名变红——只告诉你哪个文件坏了，改完一行就能继续。出现任何 HIGH 就退出 1 把 check 变红，告警也留在 GitHub 的 Security 标签页备查。扫描不发网络请求，不需要 git 或 gh。
body.en: A baseline file you keep in the repo no longer scans itself into false HIGH alarms — it only suppresses what it should, so every alert is real. Typo the YAML while trimming accepted findings or writing your own rule pack, or have a baseline/rules file saved in the wrong character encoding, and instead of an unreadable crash dump that turns CI red for no clear reason, you get one line naming the broken file — fix it and move on. Any HIGH exits 1 to turn the check red, and findings also stay on GitHub's Security tab for the record. The scan makes no network calls and needs no git or gh.

chips: › 写错 / 存错编码 · 只报错不崩

headline.zh: 在每个 PR 上拦住藏起来的注入
headline.en: Block hidden injections on every PR

sub.zh: Apache-2.0 许可，pip install promptshield 即用；把仓库自带的 workflow 复制进 .github/workflows/，每个 PR 自动拦住高风险注入。
sub.en: Apache-2.0-licensed, pip install promptshield; copy the bundled workflow into .github/workflows/ and every PR auto-blocks HIGH injections.

changelog.en: promptshield v0.13.0 closes a quadratic DoS in the comment finder: _find_line_comment re-walked the line prefix for each in-string marker occurrence (O(n²)), so a single line opening a quote then filling with # chars hung the scanner for ~29s on 50k chars. Rewritten to a single forward scan tracking quote/escape state (O(n)) — the same ReDoS-class hardening v0.12.0 applied to the string-literal regex, now on the comment path.
changelog.zh: promptshield v0.13.0 修复注释查找器的二次复杂度 DoS：_find_line_comment 对每个字符串内的标记位都从头重扫前缀（O(n²)），一行开引号后填满 # 字符能让扫描器在 5 万字符下挂死约 29 秒。重写为单遍正向扫描、增量跟踪引号/转义状态（O(n)）——与 v0.12.0 对字符串字面量正则的 ReDoS 加固同源，这次落在注释路径上。

changelog.en: promptshield v0.12.0 closed a ReDoS in the string-literal regex (a crafted line could hang the scanner) and tightened string-literal marker detection so a marker inside a quoted string no longer hides a trailing comment.
changelog.zh: promptshield v0.12.0 修复字符串字面量正则的 ReDoS（构造的一行能让扫描器挂死），并收紧字符串字面量标记检测：引号字符串内的标记不再能隐藏后续注释。

changelog.en: promptshield v0.11.0 hardens detection + CLI: closes a multi-line-triple false-negative (an injection hidden as the second operand of an implicit string concat after a single-line triple was silently dropped in v0.10.0); guards the --update-baseline WRITE against a raw OSError traceback (the WRITE sibling of the v0.8-v0.10 LOAD-side crash arc); and extends the homoglyph map so a single Cyrillic i no longer hides `ignore all previous instructions` from any scan mode.
changelog.zh: promptshield v0.11.0 强化检测与 CLI：修复多行三引号隐式拼接导致的漏报（藏于单行 triple 之后的注入此前被静默丢弃）；为 --update-baseline 写入加 OSError 防护（v0.8–v0.10 读侧崩溃的同源写侧崩溃）；扩展同形字映射，单个西里尔字母 і 不再能隐藏 'ignore all previous instructions'。
当 --rules 规则包存在错误的正则、severity 或缺失字段时，scan 与 rules list 现在都会抛出干净错误（而非原始 traceback）——两者共享同一个受守护的加载器，不会再各自为政。
changelog.en: scan and rules list now surface a clean error (not a raw traceback) when a --rules pack has a bad regex, severity, or missing key — the guarded loader is shared by both commands so they can't diverge.
